# Diff

**Status:** decorative. **Category:** data-display. **In the demo:** `/gallery/diff`.

This repository's rules come first. Where this page disagrees with [Standards](../standards.md) or
[AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md), they win: no CDN, no npm, no images from other servers, no inline `style` or `onclick`.
Use the [macros](../../../app/ui/templates/ui/macros.html) where one exists.

Use the diff component to show a side-by-side comparison of two items.

[Diff documentation](https://daisyui.com/components/diff/)

## Class names
- component: `diff`
- part: `diff-item-1`, `diff-item-2`, `diff-resizer`

## Syntax
```html
<figure class="diff">
  <div class="diff-item-1">{item1}</div>
  <div class="diff-item-2">{item2}</div>
  <div class="diff-resizer"></div>
</figure>
```

## Rules
- To keep the aspect ratio, add `aspect-16/9` or another aspect-ratio class to the `<figure class="diff">` element.
